listing.title: Handcrafted Wheel-Thrown Terracotta Water Pot - 2 Liters
listing.description: Hand-thrown on a traditional potter's wheel, this terracotta water pot represents the timeless heritage of Indian clay craftsmanship. Each piece is carefully shaped over half a day, ensuring a functional design that naturally cools water through the porous properties of the earth. This craft reflects a dedication to sustainable, handmade utility items passed down through generations.
